$comment: Normative producer-body samples for the six legs of
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (TASK-PC-FE-295): console-bff loads each producer's
response body VERBATIM into `cards[i].data`, but the two sides were tested
against different invented shapes — the bff slice seeded `Map.of("balance", 0)`
and the web test seeded `{ balance: { amount, currency } }`, while the finance
producer actually emits `{ data: [ { currency, ledger, available, held } ] }`.
Both suites were green and the operator saw «잔액 정보 없음». Three of the six
cards were broken this way at once.
So this is ONE set, consumed by BOTH suites:
A card renderer that cannot read the body below is a DEFECT, not a fixture gap.
Each `body` is the producer's 200 response, shaped from the producer's own
controller/DTO code (not from prose), with provenance in `sourceOfShape`.

iam.sourceOfShape: iam-platform admin-service AccountAdminController#search -> AccountServiceClient.AccountSearchResponse(content, totalElements, page, size, totalPages)

wms.surfaced: inventory snapshot row count (page.totalElements) — NOT a sum of stock units; see § 2.4.9.1 leg data shapes

scm.sourceOfShape: scm-platform inventory-visibility-service InventoryVisibilityController#getSnapshot (no nodeId branch) -> ApiEnvelope.of(PageResponse<SnapshotResponse>, meta) = { data: { content, page, size, totalElements, totalPages }, meta: { timestamp, warning, staleness } }
scm.surfaced: snapshot row count (data.totalElements) + the S5 meta.warning hint

finance.sourceOfShape: finance-platform account-service AccountController#balances -> ApiEnvelope.of(List<AccountResponse.BalanceResponse(currency, ledger, available, held)>) = { data: [ ... ], meta }
finance.surfaced: balance availability + currency (F5: every money field is a minor-units STRING and is never coerced)

erp.sourceOfShape: erp-platform masterdata-service DepartmentController#list -> ApiEnvelope.ofList(data, page, size, totalElements, totalPages) = { data: [ ... ], meta: { page, size, totalElements, totalPages, timestamp } }

ecommerce.sourceOfShape: ecommerce product-service AdminProductController#list -> ProductListResponse(content, page, size, totalElements, totalPages)
